input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic ambulatory monitoring clinic reported a routine software validation finding for the complete atrioventricular block detection pathway. The synthetic incident narrative references a prior unrelated deployment log as if it supported this case; that citation does not actually describe this device or this event. No patient-facing exposure occurred and the engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.
